description: This file defines HTTP handlers for managing observability webhook configurations, status, dead letter queue, and related operations in a Go web service using the Gin framework.

classes.name: ObservabilityWebhookHandler
classes.description: Struct that handles observability webhook management, including CRUD operations and status checks.

methods.name: NewObservabilityWebhookHandler
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new instance of ObservabilityWebhookHandler.

methods.name: SetWebhookHandler
methods.description: Creates or updates the webhook configuration based on the request.

methods.name: GetStatusHandler
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the observability forwarder.

methods.name: RedriveHandler
methods.description: Attempts to redrive (resend) all events from the dead letter queue.

methods.name: GetDeadLetterQueueHandler
methods.description: Fetches entries from the dead letter queue with pagination.

methods.name: ClearDeadLetterQueueHandler
methods.description: Clears all entries from the dead letter queue.
